zn_rt_steeped_jug: lifts the cloth from a clay jug of dark herbal infusion that has steeped overnight, steam rising.
zn_rt_dried_root: holds up a twisted dried root bound with red thread, bundles of herbs hanging around her.
zn_rt_old_woman_brew: stirs a small black pot over a fire in a cramped hut, muttering a recipe, smoke curling.
zn_pw_herb_drying: hangs bundles of herbs to dry under the eaves of a hut, rows of them swaying in the wind.
zn_pw_gentle_hands: lays her scarred hands gently on the bandaged head of a wounded warrior lying on straw.
zn_pw_bitter_root: chews a bitter root and grimaces, a black drop running from her mouth onto the snow.
zn_pw_healer_charm: ties a small herb charm around the wrist of a frightened young warrior before a battle.
zn_pw_poison_garden: walks through a garden of dark poisonous flowers and wormwood under a grey sky, a sickle in hand.
zn_pw_endless_pot: stands before a huge black cauldron that bubbles by itself over a fire that never goes out.
zn_pw_wise_hands: sorts many herbs, roots and jars on a table with quick sure hands, an old book open beside her.
